purpose: One bounded exploratory gate experiment on reused validation; not a new independent test
split: SHA256(seed-prefix plus canonical full39 float32 vector), first uint64 modulo 10: 0..5 fit, 6..7 calibration, 8..9 internal audit
inputs: 39 existing standardized flow features plus 8 base softmax outputs; no specialist outputs, labels, row IDs or group hashes
target: 0 neither repair nor harm; 1 base wrong and specialist correct; 2 base correct and specialist wrong
sample_weight: inverse true-class frequency in capped fit subset, with benign multiplier 2, normalized to mean one
score: weighted leaf repair fraction minus weighted leaf harm fraction; not a calibrated probability
calibration: Whole-tie thresholds at 0..10% quotas in 0.1 percentage-point increments; maximize macro-F1 subject to budget and benign false-alert count <= base; ties choose fewer calls; zero calls always available
audit: Freeze all six gate JSONs and calibration decisions before audit metrics; apply fixed thresholds without audit sorting, quota adjustment or labels; report actual rates and any constraint violation
continue_rule: At a predeclared budget, every paired seed must respect realized audit budget and base false-alert count, improve macro-F1 over base and both rare recalls over base, and match or beat guarded confidence and random balanced-fallback F1; otherwise no promotion or automatic search
